verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs extensively detail LLM-as-a-judge evaluators that are model-agnostic via adapters (OpenAI, LiteLLM, LangChain, AI SDK), configurable in UI or code, return explanations, support retry/concurrency at scale, and can be run on traces, experiments, or datasets. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs of judge accuracy or configurability in practice.
